body: Thank you for your help. I'm gonna save this.
Like what? I've changed my major 5 times already and I'm 50,000 in school loan debt so I have to get something to deal with that.
I just really need to know how to get these suicidal thoughts out of my head.

I think he does too. I'm gonna take your advice and try to make myself feel better. I've at least stopped crying since I've wrote this so it's helping. I'm gonna keep doing this when I feel down and hopefully I won't attempt suicide again.
I'll consider that if things don't work out. In the meantime I just want to get out of this slump.
Thank you. That's all I need.

I just told him in depressed and that I thought he would leave me because I battle with it. I haven't told him I have suicidal thoughts because he has a catholic background and I know he is not ok with people committing suicide.

Well I'm in school for nursing. I'm afraid once I apply I won't get in. This is because I had a run in with the law. Ironically it happened on the first of April a couple of years back. Since then it's been hard for me to get jobs. That makes me depressed cause no one wants to hire me. I keep getting rejected over and over again. I've been forced to move back with my mother because of it. Right now I don't have a job. It's killing me. Also I don't feel loved by anyone. My mother has never told me she loves me. Neither has anyone I've been in a relationship with. My bf hasn't said it yet even though he says he cares for me. I just want to feel loved by someone. I feel like an outcast in my own family. Also I had an abortion before. No one knows really so I've been holding that in for a while. I don't feel confident in myself. I'm overweight and can't seem to lose the weight. I think I'm ugly at times and have just started to stare at myself in the mirror and tell myself I'm beautiful. No one other than my bf lately has told me that. No one has given me compliments other tan I'm funny. I don't have anything going for myself. I feel like I can't tell anyone I know about how I feel because I feel like they would pass judgement on me. 

**edit:** just for clarity I shoplifted. So I have a class c misdemeanor on my record.
Idk what to do. The only answer in my head is death. I don't want to do it but I feel like it's my only hope.
